name: 2019 Spring Lao Ban Zhang Puerh Tea - 200g Cake
marketing_tip: Authentic ancient tree Puerh from the legendary Lao Ban Zhang village.
body: Sourced from the prestigious Lao Ban Zhang village in Yunnan, this 2019 spring harvest Puerh cake is made from pure ancient tree leaves. It offers a powerful, complex flavor and a strong cha qi that Puerh collectors prize.
